role: A 16-type personality code (four letters) and an age -> a sample birth date that makes that age today, drawn reproducibly, and the code's four axes (our own mapping for fun; not affiliated with The Myers-Briggs Company)
sample_rule: Range: the dates D with today - (age+1) years < D <= today - age years (a 29 February anchor in a non-leap year is 28 February). Seed: sha256('mbti-fortune|v1|' + TYPE + '|' + age + '|' + today) as a hex integer, TYPE the four upper-case letters without -A/-T, today YYYY-MM-DD in Asia/Seoul. The sample is the range's dates in ascending order at index seed mod the range's length. A range outside 1912-2100 is refused (invalid_input), never redrawn.

sample_notice.const: The birth date is a sample drawn from your age, not your real birthday.

rules: answer and source are required, as in every contract; the structured fields are optional and our own substitute fills them all
the sample birth date follows sample_rule exactly (the gate recomputes it); the answer says it is a sample, not the real birthday
the type is the four upper-case letters (-A/-T ignored); the axes are our own mapping for fun, not affiliated with The Myers-Briggs Company
a range outside 1912-2100 is refused (invalid_input), never redrawn
read-only calculation; no account, payment or write; the type and age are never stored or logged
